title: Hosted Commons identity and public attribution verified locally
statement: The production edge frontend was exercised through the real edge HTTP adapter backed by SQLite with isolated Alice, Bob and anonymous browser contexts. Contribution, reply, public rediscovery, expiry/revocation recovery, session reload, offline logout and failed-draft retention passed; this is local browser evidence, not a deployed or workerd browser result.
conditions: Unreviewed assistant finding; only a human review record can accept it.
Evidence is local SQLite-backed browser coverage; public deployment, Cloudflare D1/workerd browser parity and two physical devices were not verified.
Checked-in context packet cutoff 93a5445150d0 is an ancestor of task baseline 473adcf and was treated as historical orientation.
